links.title: Nivesh Mitra 3.0 — Single Window Portal
links.note: UP's single-window system for investor approvals and clearances.

detail.owner: Department of Infrastructure & Industrial Development (IIDD), Govt. of UP
detail.whatItGives: Application tracking and department-wise clearance status for registered investors/units.
detail.typicalUse: Checking or progressing a specific unit's clearance status.
quirks: Session times out quickly on shared connections

links.title: Nivesh Mitra — Know Your Approvals
links.note: Wizard tool that lists exactly which approvals a given business/industry needs.

detail.owner: Department of Infrastructure & Industrial Development (IIDD), Govt. of UP
detail.whatItGives: A guided checklist of required departmental clearances based on sector, scale, and location inputs — answers 'what do I even need to apply for' before touching Nivesh Mitra proper.
detail.typicalUse: First question from a new investor: 'what approvals will I need?' — run this before opening a full application.
quirks: Still hosted on the legacy niveshmitra.up.nic.in domain even though the main portal has moved to niveshmitra.up.gov.in — this may migrate; re-verify if it 404s

links.title: Nivesh Sarathi — Investor CRM & Grievance Portal
links.note: Invest UP's CRM for investment intents, land facilitation requests, and grievance redressal.

detail.whatItGives: One place for investors to log investment intent, request land facilitation, raise a query against any department, and track resolution — distinct from Nivesh Mitra, which is for formal statutory clearances.
detail.typicalUse: Escalating a stuck investor query, or logging a new investment intent/land requirement for facilitation.
quirks: Launched Nov 2022 — newer and less well-known than Nivesh Mitra; don't confuse the two by name

links.title: UPSIDA OBPAS — Online Building Plan Approval System
links.note: Online submission and approval of building plans within UPSIDA industrial areas.

detail.whatItGives: End-to-end online building-plan submission, scrutiny, and approval workflow for allottees, architects, and UPSIDA officers.
detail.typicalUse: Guiding an allottee through building-plan approval, or checking where a submitted plan stands.
quirks: Separate logins/roles for allottee, architect, and officer — point the right party to the right role

links.title: UPSIDA — E-Auction Notices
links.note: Live and upcoming plot e-auction notices, organised by region.

detail.whatItGives: Region-wise (Agra, Aligarh, Ayodhya, Bareilly, Ghaziabad, and more) listing of plots currently or soon up for e-auction, with notice PDFs.
detail.typicalUse: Time-sensitive — checking whether a specific district has an active auction an investor could bid in.
